resources.string: Shows photos from an iCloud Shared Album as a TV screensaver.
URL saved. Enable the screensaver in TV Settings → Screen saver.
Please enter a valid iCloud Shared Album URL.
How to get the album URL

1. Open Photos on your iPhone or iPad.

2. Tap the album you want to share, then tap the Share button (or the person icon).

3. Enable Shared Album if it isn't already on.

4. Tap Copy Link — this gives you a URL that looks like:
 https://photos.icloud.com/shared/album/…

5. Paste it in the field above and tap Save.

After saving, go to TV Settings → Device Preferences → Screen saver and choose iCloud Photos.
